name: Unicorn, Lightbringer
body:
Unicorn, Lightbringer
CR 7

This unicorn seems larger and even more majestic than others of its kind. It displays its horn proudly, its radiance almost blinding.

XP 3,200
CG Large magical beast (good)
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +16
Aura bless (50 ft.), magic circle against evil (10 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+5 Dex, +5 natural, –1 size; +2 deflection vs. evil)
hp 63 (6d10+30)
Fort +10, Ref +10, Will +9; +2 resistance vs. evil; DR 5/magic and evil
Immune charm, compulsion, fear, poison; SR 18

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee gore +13 (2d6+6 plus radiance), 2 hooves +10 (1d3+3)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks channel positive energy (4d6, DC 22, 12/day), powerful charge (gore +15, 4d6+9)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; concentration +19)

Constant—bless, detect evil, magic circle against evil
3/day—blinding ray (DC 21), burst of radiance (DC 21), cure moderate wounds, searing light
1/day—cure critical wounds, greater teleport (within its forest territory), neutralize poison (DC 21), wall of light (DC 24)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 21, Con 20, Int 15, Wis 25, Cha 28
Base Atk +6; CMB +13; CMD 28 (32 vs. trip)
Feats Multiattack, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (gore)
Skills Diplomacy +15, Perception +16, Survival +13, Stealth +10
Languages Celestial, Common, Sylvan
SQ wild empathy +23

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Channel Positive Energy (Su)

As a standard action, a lightbringer unicorn can channel positive energy in a 30-foot burst as a 7th-level good cleric. This ability requires no divine focus.

Radiance (Su)

The horn of a lightbringer unicorn constantly shines as if under the effect of the daylight spell, which the lightbringer unicorn can suppress or resume as a free action. When the horn is shining, a creature hit by the lightbringer unicorn’s gore attack must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude save or be permanently blinded. A creature that succeeds at this save is instead dazzled for 1 round. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Wild Empathy (Su)

This works like the druid’s wild empathy class feature, except the lightbringer unicorn has a +8 racial bonus on the check.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate forests
Organization solitary, pair, or crusade (3-6)
Treasure standard

While all unicorns are enemies of evil, lightbringer unicorns are invested with power and purpose uncommon to their kind. Lightbringer unicorns boast a much stronger connection to good than their weaker siblings, rivaling even that of good-aligned outsiders. Paragons of their kind, lightbringer unicorns are able to use much more potent healing magic and bolster themselves and their allies with a blessing they carry. They are larger and stronger than most unicorns, and thus able to face more powerful adversaries in combat. Other than their physical and magical prowess, all lightbringer unicorns possess powerful, brightly glowing horns which give them their name. They can not only banish even the deepest darkness with their radiance, but also focus and bend their light in many incredible ways. In combat, a lightbringer unicorn has a formidable arsenal of light-based abilities, from simply blinding their opponents, through shooting out rays able to destroy undead on the spot, to constructing temporary walls of blinding, almost solid light.

Unlike their brethren, lightbringer unicorns are not shy or reclusive. They are valiant crusaders for good, and while they occasionally still guard great forests or glades, they are much more likely to hunt down evil wherever it may be. A lightbringer unicorn can be found sending undead to their final rest in a haunted graveyard, scattering a camp of particularly bloodthirsty bandits or hunting down an escaped fiend summoned by a reckless wizard. Lightbringer unicorns have a very low tolerance for evil, and will serve self-judged justice without a second thought, trusting in their own wisdom and moral compass. While most of them are solitary, some lightbringer unicorns gather in groups to fight against greater evils, or even ally themselves with paladins or clerics of good deities. Rarely, such an alliance might outlive such a campaign, and sometimes a lightbringer unicorn will choose a particularly valiant hero as its rider and companion if it believes such a union will lead it to greater success in hunting down evil.

As a result of its vastly increased potency, a powdered horn of a lightbringer unicorn is worth 5,000 gp when used as a component for crafting magic items associated with either light or healing magic. As an advanced variant of a unicorn, a lightbringer unicorn cannot gain or benefit from the advanced simple template.
